name: Miwa Kazumi
source:
She is well-liked by people around her as a friendly and bubbly wife, she is also a member of a mommy's volleyball team. In reality she is actually a horny and dirty wife who is always looking for somewhere to release her agonizing sexual desires. 

This is partly because she got married young and had a child, and spent most of her twenties being a housewife, when she could have been having fun. To ease her sexual desire, she masturbates in the supermarket where she sells her products. She eventually shoplifts for a cheap thrill.

She is caught by the main character, a loss prevention officer who is also her customer, and while being threatened, she allows him to use her body whilst being mindful of her appearance. The passion inside her that she suppressed for a long time is finally released.

Hobby: Volleyball

"Making a living with two kids is hard. I wish people would buy the 6 month package instead..."
